message.content:
This editorial illustration features a red background with white and black text at the top. The word "TEMPO" is printed in large black serif font. Below it, white text reads "PEPESAN KOSONG" and "JEDA KEMANUASIAN." Further down, smaller white text begins with "Jeda kemanusiaan Papua jalan di tempat..." ending with "H.24."

The central image depicts a small, emaciated humanoid figure with a large, rounded head and thin limbs. The figure is barefoot, wearing only a white cloth wrapped around its waist, and is positioned in a profile-view stride. The figure's hands are pressed against a massive black firearm, similar in shape to an assault rifle with a carrying handle and a curved magazine. The gun is angled diagonally across the frame, dwarfing the figure. The figure appears to be pushing or straining against the weapon’s underside. The scene takes place on a dark, rocky, uneven terrain that slopes upward. Several small black rock fragments are scattered in the air around the figure's feet. The lighting comes from the upper left, casting the figure and objects in high-contrast shadow.
